rituals.title: THE BLAME PIE
rituals.name: THE BLAME PIE
rituals.hook: Catch: Owning your part is different from taking all the blame.
rituals.hook_internal: Catch: Owning your part is different from taking all the blame.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Imagine A Pie → Check The Whole → Choose Repair
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Imagine A Pie → Check The Whole → Choose Repair
rituals.goal: Owning your part is different from taking all the blame.
rituals.mission: Owning your part is different from taking all the blame.
rituals.challenge: Owning your part is different from taking all the blame.
rituals.immediate_need: Owning your part is different from taking all the blame.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Self-blame, guilt & shame

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Owning your part is different from taking all the blame.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Imagine A Pie — Imagine a pie that stands for everything that caused the situation. Blame Pie — breathe naturally.
2. Share The Slices — In your mind, give slices to your choices, other people, circumstances, systems, timing, and chance.
3. Check The Whole — Make sure all slices together equal 100. Blame Pie — split duty.
4. Find Your Slice — Focus only on your true share.
5. Choose Repair — Picture one repair for your slice. Let the rest stay outside your responsibility. Blame Pie — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Repair.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ I found my slice. I don't own the whole pie.
rituals.formula_flow: Imagine A Pie → Share The Slices → Check The Whole → Find Your Slice → Choose Repair
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Set it down if sharing turns into punishment or erases genuine accountability.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.hook: Zoom: A thought can sound true and still drive badly.
rituals.hook_internal: Zoom: A thought can sound true and still drive badly.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Picture → Name Likely → Select Direction
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Picture → Name Likely → Select Direction
rituals.goal: A thought can sound true and still drive badly.
rituals.mission: A thought can sound true and still drive badly.
rituals.challenge: A thought can sound true and still drive badly.
rituals.immediate_need: A thought can sound true and still drive badly.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Values, meaning & loss

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A thought can sound true and still drive badly.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Picture — Picture two arrows. Life Direction — feel support.
2. Make Room — One shows the next hour if you obey the thought; the other reveals what unfolds over sixty minutes when you make room for it but follow a chosen value.
3. Name Likely — Name the likely behaviour at each arrow’s end. Life Direction — split duty.
4. Select Direction — Select by direction, not by mental volume. Life Direction — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Select Direction.

✓ A thought can sound true and still drive badly.

rituals.title: CLOSE ONE DOOR FOR THIRTY SECONDS
rituals.name: CLOSE ONE DOOR FOR THIRTY SECONDS
rituals.ritual_name: CLOSE ONE DOOR FOR THIRTY SECONDS
rituals.hook: Spot: A hidden preference often speaks when one door briefly closes.
rituals.hook_internal: Spot: A hidden preference often speaks when one door briefly closes.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Close Door → Reopen Choice → Choose Next
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Close Door → Reopen Choice → Choose Next
rituals.goal: A hidden preference often speaks when one door briefly closes.
rituals.mission: A hidden preference often speaks when one door briefly closes.
rituals.challenge: A hidden preference often speaks when one door briefly closes.
rituals.immediate_need: A hidden preference often speaks when one door briefly closes.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Perfectionism & performance pressure

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A hidden preference often speaks when one door briefly closes.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Close Door — Picture the two leading options. Cross out one for thirty seconds and pretend it is unavailable; do not commit. Close Door — hear sound.
2. Read Protest — Notice the first specific reaction—relief, disappointment, bargaining, urgency, or no change. Name it in four words or fewer.
3. Reopen Choice — Uncross the option. Repeat once with the other door closed so both reactions receive the same test. Close Door — pick action.
4. Choose Next — Use the clearer reaction as one piece of data, then choose only the next responsible move. Close Door — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Next.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ I just found a next choice without solving my whole future.
rituals.formula_flow: Close Door → Read Protest → Reopen Choice → Choose Next
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Do not use pretend closure for urgent, coercive, unsafe, or irreversible choices.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.
rituals.safety_notes:

GOAL
When the Imagine a path is missing, choose the way of walking.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Ask Quality — Ask: ‘What quality do I want this next action to carry?’ Pick one—honesty, courage, care, fairness, patience. Value Before — feel support.
2. Look Single — Define how that quality would look in a single visible movement today. Value Before — split duty.
3. Let Certainty — Let certainty remain absent while the compass gives direction. Value Before — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Let Certainty.

rituals.title: THE THIRD VOICE

rituals.hook: Twist: Emotion and logic are witnesses; wisdom gives the final answer.

rituals.game_move: PLAY: Open Voices → Name Facts → Use Wisdom

rituals.goal: Emotion and logic are witnesses; wisdom gives the final answer.
rituals.mission: Emotion and logic are witnesses; wisdom gives the final answer.
rituals.challenge: Emotion and logic are witnesses; wisdom gives the final answer.
rituals.immediate_need: Emotion and logic are witnesses; wisdom gives the final answer.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Emotional reasoning

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Emotion and logic are witnesses; wisdom gives the final answer.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Open Voices — Complete three lines. Third Voice — soften shoulders.
2. Name Feeling — FEELING SAYS: include its full truth.
3. Name Facts — FACTS SAY: include only verified information. Third Voice — name feeling.
4. Build Wisdom — WISE RESPONSE: honour the need in the first line and the constraints in the second.
5. Use Wisdom — Read only the third line before acting. Third Voice — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Use Wisdom.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ Emotion and logic are witnesses; wisdom gives the final answer.
rituals.formula_flow: Open Voices → Name Feeling → Name Facts → Build Wisdom → Use Wisdom
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Delay major action if either witness is too impaired to give usable information.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.title: TRACK WHAT HOLDS
rituals.name: TRACK WHAT HOLDS
rituals.hook: Watch: Support becomes stronger when it receives precise attention.
rituals.hook_internal: Watch: Support becomes stronger when it receives precise attention.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Locate Bodily → Ask Memory → Add Ingredient

rituals.goal: Support becomes stronger when it receives precise attention.
rituals.mission: Support becomes stronger when it receives precise attention.
rituals.challenge: Support becomes stronger when it receives precise attention.
rituals.immediate_need: Support becomes stronger when it receives precise attention.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Urges, impulses & cravings

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Support becomes stronger when it receives precise attention.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Locate Bodily — Locate one bodily sign of steadiness—warmth, pressure, uprightness, ease, or a capable impulse. Track Holds — press feet.
2. Describe Boundaries — Say its boundaries and changes for twenty seconds.
3. Ask Memory — Ask what memory, person, posture, or environment strengthens it by one degree. Track Holds — name feeling.
4. Add Ingredient — Add only that ingredient. Track Holds — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Add Ingredient.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ Support becomes stronger when it receives precise attention.
rituals.formula_flow: Locate Bodily → Describe Boundaries → Ask Memory → Add Ingredient
rituals.safety:

Choose an external anchor if internal tracking feels inaccessible or unsafe.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.name: MAP YOUR OPERATING WINDOW
rituals.hook: Peek: Learn the borders before the system crosses them.
rituals.hook_internal: Peek: Learn the borders before the system crosses them.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Imagine Zones → Picture Fastest → Place Others
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Imagine Zones → Picture Fastest → Place Others
rituals.goal: Learn the borders before the system crosses them.
rituals.mission: Learn the borders before the system crosses them.
rituals.challenge: Learn the borders before the system crosses them.
rituals.immediate_need: Learn the borders before the system crosses them.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Trauma & memory-as-present

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Learn the borders before the system crosses them.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Imagine Zones — Picture three operating zones: TOO HIGH, WORKABLE, TOO LOW. Map Operating — feel support.
2. Add Earliest — Add your earliest personal signs in body, speech, attention, and behaviour.
3. Picture Fastest — Beside each outer zone, Picture the fastest safe route toward the middle. Map Operating — name sensation.
4. Place Others — Place the imagined path where others can help recognise it. Map Operating — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Place Others.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ Learn the borders before the system crosses them.
rituals.formula_flow: Imagine Zones → Add Earliest → Picture Fastest → Place Others
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Use professional guidance when shutdown, mania, trauma, or severe loss of steadiness is involved.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.title: LET BREATH BREATHE YOU
rituals.name: LET BREATH BREATHE YOU
rituals.hook: Twist: Remove the manager from respiration.
rituals.hook_internal: Twist: Remove the manager from respiration.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Follow Breaths → Start → Witness Motion
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Follow Breaths → Start → Witness Motion
rituals.goal: Remove the manager from respiration.
rituals.mission: Remove the manager from respiration.
rituals.challenge: Remove the manager from respiration.
rituals.immediate_need: Remove the manager from respiration.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Observer loss & cognitive fusion

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Remove the manager from respiration.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Follow Breaths — Follow three natural breaths exactly as they occur. Let Breath — breathe naturally.
2. Leave Breath Alone — Do not deepen, slow, count, or improve them.
3. Start — Notice where each begins by itself and where it ends without instruction. Let Breath — notice detail.
4. Let Body — Between breaths, let the body choose again.
5. Witness Motion — Your only action is witnessing what already knows how to move. Let Breath — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Witness Motion.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ Remove the manager from respiration.
rituals.formula_flow: Follow Breaths → Leave Breath Alone → Start → Let Body → Witness Motion
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Use outward sensory contact if breath attention increases panic or air hunger.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

GOAL
Remove the manager from respiration.

1. Follow Breaths — Follow three natural breaths exactly as they occur. Let Breath — breathe naturally.
2. Leave Breath Alone — Do not deepen, slow, count, or improve them.
3. Start — Notice where each begins by itself and where it ends without instruction. Let Breath — notice detail.
4. Let Body — Between breaths, let the body choose again.
5. Witness Motion — Your only action is witnessing what already knows how to move. Let Breath — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Witness Motion.
rituals.win_reward_source: ✓ Remove the manager from respiration.

rituals.goal: Symmetry gives attention a simple crossing.
rituals.mission: Symmetry gives attention a simple crossing.
rituals.challenge: Symmetry gives attention a simple crossing.

rituals.goal_why_game_move:

Symmetry gives attention a simple crossing.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Pick Requires — Pick a count that requires no effort. Even Bridge — widen gaze.
2. Count Exhale — Inhale for that count, exhale for the same count, and leave any natural pause untouched.
3. Imagine Pair — Imagine each pair forming equal sides of a bridge. Even Bridge — name sensation.
4. Complete Few — Complete a few balanced crossings, then let counting dissolve. Even Bridge — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Complete Few.

rituals.plain:
SAME VALUE, TWO OUTCOMES

TRIGGER
Evidence distortion & selective thinking

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes

GOAL
Stability is trained before the verdict arrives.

1. Imagine Action — Imagine the action succeeding. Same Value — soften shoulders.
2. State Governing — State how your governing value behaves next.
3. Imagine Failing — Imagine it failing. Same Value — allow opposite.
4. State Value — State how the same value responds there.
5. Let Outcome — Let outcome alter strategy, not your ethical centre. Same Value — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Let Outcome.

WIN SIGNAL
✓ Stability is trained before the verdict arrives.

FORMULA FLOW
Imagine Action → State Governing → Imagine Failing → State Value → Let Outcome

rituals.title: EMPTY THE MENTAL COUNTERTOP
rituals.name: EMPTY THE MENTAL COUNTERTOP
rituals.hook: Peek: Short-term attention is not permanent storage.
rituals.hook_internal: Peek: Short-term attention is not permanent storage.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Question Promise → Sort Entries → Choose Physical
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Question Promise → Sort Entries → Choose Physical
rituals.goal: Short-term attention is not permanent storage.
rituals.mission: Short-term attention is not permanent storage.
rituals.challenge: Short-term attention is not permanent storage.
rituals.immediate_need: Short-term attention is not permanent storage.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Attention & cognitive overload

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Short-term attention is not permanent storage.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Question Promise — Catch every task, question, promise, and loose obligation into one trusted place. Empty Mental — feel support.
2. Empty First — Do not organise while emptying.
3. Sort Entries — When the mind offers silence, sort entries into do, schedule, delegate, reference, or delete. Empty Mental — notice detail.
4. Choose Physical — Choose only the first physical action. Empty Mental — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Physical.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ Short-term attention is not permanent storage.
rituals.formula_flow: Question Promise → Empty First → Sort Entries → Choose Physical

rituals.challenge: Clear and firmness needs structure when emotion bends the message.

rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Boundaries & over-responsibility

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Clear and firmness needs structure when emotion bends the message.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Describe Situation — Say the visible situation. Request Spine — breathe naturally.
2. Express Impact — Express its impact.
3. Assert Request — Assert the exact request or no. Request Spine — pick action.
4. Reinforce Cooperation — Reinforce why cooperation helps.
5. Picture Sentence — Picture one sentence for each part, then deliver the leanest version. Request Spine — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Picture Sentence.

rituals.hook: Imagine: Two competing experiences can become one pattern.

rituals.game_move: PLAY: Choose Signals → Hold Time → Decide After
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Choose Signals → Hold Time → Decide After
rituals.goal: Two competing experiences can become one pattern.
rituals.mission: Two competing experiences can become one pattern.
rituals.challenge: Two competing experiences can become one pattern.
rituals.immediate_need: Two competing experiences can become one pattern.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Attention & cognitive overload

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Two competing experiences can become one pattern.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Choose Signals — Choose the two signals fighting for attention. Braid Signals — feel support.
2. Alternate B — Alternate A–B–A–B at a slow fixed rhythm.
3. Hold Time — Then hold both at the same time for one interval, noticing difference without choosing. Braid Signals — notice detail.
4. Decide After — Decide only after the braid is complete. Braid Signals — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Decide After.

rituals.title: MATCH THE PRESSURE, THEN ZERO IT
rituals.name: MATCH THE PRESSURE, THEN ZERO IT
rituals.ritual_name: MATCH THE PRESSURE, THEN ZERO IT
rituals.hook: Flip: Equal pressure gives restless energy a shared route down.
rituals.hook_internal: Flip: Equal pressure gives restless energy a shared route down.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Press Equal → Step Down → Reach Zero
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Press Equal → Step Down → Reach Zero
rituals.goal: Equal pressure gives restless energy a shared route down.
rituals.mission: Equal pressure gives restless energy a shared route down.
rituals.challenge: Equal pressure gives restless energy a shared route down.
rituals.immediate_need: Equal pressure gives restless energy a shared route down.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Urges, impulses & cravings

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Equal pressure gives restless energy a shared route down.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Press Equal — Press palms together—or both hands into one cushion—at about twenty percent effort. Keep breathing ordinary. Match Pressure — move slowly.
2. Match Force — Adjust until neither side wins and the pressure feels equal. Hold that match for two seconds.
3. Step Down — Lower both sides together through three gentle levels: fifteen, ten, then five percent. Match Pressure — name feeling.
4. Reach Zero — Reach zero, rest both hands on a stable surface, and observe whether the urge to press returns. Match Pressure — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Reach Zero.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ Equal pressure gives restless energy a shared route down.
rituals.formula_flow: Press Equal → Match Force → Step Down → Reach Zero
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Avoid this with pain, hand or joint injury, numbness, breath holding, or any unsafe physical symptom.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.name: COUNT EVERY OPEN LOOP
rituals.hook: Bet: Invisible commitments keep using memory until named.
rituals.hook_internal: Bet: Invisible commitments keep using memory until named.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Question Task → Use Line → Imagine Boundary
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Question Task → Use Line → Imagine Boundary
rituals.goal: Invisible commitments keep using memory until named.
rituals.mission: Invisible commitments keep using memory until named.
rituals.challenge: Invisible commitments keep using memory until named.
rituals.immediate_need: Invisible commitments keep using memory until named.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Attention & cognitive overload

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Invisible commitments keep using memory until named.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Question Task — Name every unresolved promise, question, task, decision, and waiting item without solving any. Count Every — loosen hands.
2. Use Line — Use one line each. Count Every — notice detail.
3. Imagine Boundary — When nothing else appears for thirty seconds, Imagine a boundary around the inventory and choose a separate processing time. Count Every — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Imagine Boundary.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ Invisible commitments keep using memory until named.
rituals.formula_flow: Question Task → Use Line → Imagine Boundary
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
End the capture if Name-making increases overwhelm without containment.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.name: SEPARATE THE MENTAL INBOXES
rituals.hook: Aim: Ideas, duties, fears, and memories should not share one queue.
rituals.hook_internal: Aim: Ideas, duties, fears, and memories should not share one queue.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Question Capture → Give Category → Don't Determine

rituals.goal: Ideas, duties, fears, and memories should not share one queue.

rituals.challenge: Ideas, duties, fears, and memories should not share one queue.
rituals.immediate_need: Ideas, duties, fears, and memories should not share one queue.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Attention & cognitive overload

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Ideas, duties, fears, and memories should not share one queue.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Question Capture — Catch each mental item, then route it into IDEA, OBLIGATION, FEAR, MEMORY, or QUESTION. Separate Mental — breathe naturally.
2. Give Category — Give each category its own processing rule. Separate Mental — notice detail.
3. Don't Determine — Prioritise only after sorting, so emotional intensity does not determine inbox order. Separate Mental — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Don't Determine.

rituals.safety:

Add categories sparingly; excessive sorting can become avoidance.

Body-state misreading

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Low stimulation can be trained in measured exposure.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Choose Safe — Set up a boring task that is safe and preselect a short interval. Boring Dose — loosen hands.
2. Remove Entertainment — Remove entertainment but keep necessary tools.
3. Stay Boredom — Stay with boredom’s body sensations until the timer ends, then stop even if you could continue. Boring Dose — name sensation.
4. Increase — Increase future doses slowly. Boring Dose — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Increase.

WIN SIGNAL
✓ Low stimulation can be trained in measured exposure.
rituals.formula_flow: Choose Safe → Remove Entertainment → Stay Boredom → Increase
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Adapt for attention disorders and never use boredom as punishment.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Analysis needs an exit before fatigue corrupts it.

1. Repeat No — Define your personal decline signs in advance: rereading, harsher certainty, slower comprehension, repeated searches, no new distinctions. Mark Quality — feel support.
2. Stop Last — When two appear, stop and Hold the last reliable conclusion. Mark Quality — allow opposite.
3. Recovery — Recovery precedes any reopening. Mark Quality — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Recovery.

rituals.hook: Probe: Mental statements should not all receive one ballot.

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Mental statements should not all receive one ballot.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Score Evidence — For each influential thought, score evidence, relevant expertise, recency, and decision relevance. Give Thoughts — move slowly.
2. Multiply — Multiply nothing; simply rank. Give Thoughts — pick action.
3. Let Highest — Let the highest-quality thought advise the action while lower-ranked voices remain recorded but nonbinding. Give Thoughts — next action.

rituals.title: REMEMBER THE FUTURE IN ADVANCE
rituals.name: REMEMBER THE FUTURE IN ADVANCE
rituals.hook: Play: Desired behaviour is easier when it feels feltly familiar.
rituals.hook_internal: Play: Desired behaviour is easier when it feels feltly familiar.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Create Memory → Include Time → Look Backward
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Create Memory → Include Time → Look Backward
rituals.goal: Desired behaviour is easier when it feels feltly familiar.
rituals.mission: Desired behaviour is easier when it feels feltly familiar.
rituals.challenge: Desired behaviour is easier when it feels feltly familiar.
rituals.immediate_need: Desired behaviour is easier when it feels feltly familiar.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Grounding & present-moment loss

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Desired behaviour is easier when it feels feltly familiar.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Create Memory — Create a memory-like scene set just after completing the action. Remember Future — breathe naturally.
2. Include Time — Include time, location, body posture, one sensory cue, along with what you did when difficulty appeared. Remember Future — name sensation.
3. Look Backward — Look backward from that imagined completion to the first real movement and perform it now. Remember Future — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Look Backward.

rituals.title: INTERVIEW THE OBSTACLE
rituals.name: INTERVIEW THE OBSTACLE
rituals.hook: Spot: Resistance may be protecting something your plan ignored.
rituals.hook_internal: Spot: Resistance may be protecting something your plan ignored.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Give Obstacle → Make Step → Picture Negotiate
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Give Obstacle → Make Step → Picture Negotiate
rituals.goal: Resistance may be protecting something your plan ignored.
rituals.mission: Resistance may be protecting something your plan ignored.
rituals.challenge: Resistance may be protecting something your plan ignored.
rituals.immediate_need: Resistance may be protecting something your plan ignored.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Action avoidance & procrastination

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Resistance may be protecting something your plan ignored.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Give Obstacle — Give the obstacle a character and ask three questions: What are you protecting?. Interview Obstacle — move slowly.
2. Ask Fear — What do you fear will happen?
3. Make Step — What would make one step acceptable?. Interview Obstacle — pick action.
4. Picture Negotiate — Picture its answers, then negotiate a small action that protects the valid need without handing over total control. Interview Obstacle — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Picture Negotiate.
rituals.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ Resistance may be protecting something your plan ignored.

Choices change value while you wait.

⚡ FINISH — Sequence.

rituals.name: WHAT WOULD THIS FACT CHANGE?
rituals.hook: Watch: Missing information must earn its collection cost.
rituals.hook_internal: Watch: Missing information must earn its collection cost.
rituals.game_move: PLAY: Point Positive → Stop Collecting → Prioritise
rituals.game_move_internal: PLAY: Point Positive → Stop Collecting → Prioritise
rituals.goal: Missing information must earn its collection cost.
rituals.mission: Missing information must earn its collection cost.
rituals.challenge: Missing information must earn its collection cost.
rituals.immediate_need: Missing information must earn its collection cost.

TRIGGER

under 2 minutes
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Missing information must earn its collection cost.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Point Positive — For every desired data point, Picture how a positive, negative, or neutral result would alter the decision. Would Fact — widen gaze.
2. Stop Collecting — If no result changes action, stop collecting it. Would Fact — pick action.
3. Prioritise — Prioritise the fact with the largest possible decision swing. Would Fact — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Prioritise.

rituals.mission: A rule may fit one situation without ruling your whole life.
rituals.challenge: A rule may fit one situation without ruling your whole life.
rituals.immediate_need: A rule may fit one situation without ruling your whole life.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Boundaries & over-responsibility

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A rule may fit one situation without ruling your whole life.
rituals.play_the_loop:
1. Name The Belief — Say the belief silently. Give Belief — widen gaze.
2. Imagine Four Limits — Think about when, where, with whom, and under what conditions it may be true.
3. Test Inside — Picture one real case where it fits. Give Belief — split duty.
4. Test Outside — Picture one real case where it does not fit.
5. Set Its True Place — Say a smaller, more accurate version of the belief. Give Belief — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Set Its True Place.

✓ A rule may fit one situation without ruling your whole life.
rituals.formula_flow: Name The Belief → Imagine Four Limits → Test Inside → Test Outside → Set Its True Place

items.name: THE BLAME PIE
items.hook: Catch: Owning your part is different from taking all the blame.
items.hook_internal: Catch: Owning your part is different from taking all the blame.
items.game_move: PLAY: Imagine A Pie → Check The Whole → Choose Repair
items.game_move_internal: PLAY: Imagine A Pie → Check The Whole → Choose Repair
items.goal: Owning your part is different from taking all the blame.
items.mission: Owning your part is different from taking all the blame.
items.challenge: Owning your part is different from taking all the blame.
items.immediate_need: Owning your part is different from taking all the blame.
items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Self-blame, guilt & shame

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Owning your part is different from taking all the blame.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Imagine A Pie — Imagine a pie that stands for everything that caused the situation. Blame Pie — breathe naturally.
2. Share The Slices — In your mind, give slices to your choices, other people, circumstances, systems, timing, and chance.
3. Check The Whole — Make sure all slices together equal 100. Blame Pie — split duty.
4. Find Your Slice — Focus only on your true share.
5. Choose Repair — Picture one repair for your slice. Let the rest stay outside your responsibility. Blame Pie — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Repair.
items.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ I found my slice. I don't own the whole pie.
items.formula_flow: Imagine A Pie → Share The Slices → Check The Whole → Find Your Slice → Choose Repair
items.safety:
PAUSE
Set it down if sharing turns into punishment or erases genuine accountability.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

items.hook: Zoom: A thought can sound true and still drive badly.

Values, meaning & loss

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A thought can sound true and still drive badly.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Picture — Picture two arrows. Life Direction — feel support.
2. Make Room — One shows the next hour if you obey the thought; the other reveals what unfolds over sixty minutes when you make room for it but follow a chosen value.
3. Name Likely — Name the likely behaviour at each arrow’s end. Life Direction — split duty.
4. Select Direction — Select by direction, not by mental volume. Life Direction — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Select Direction.

items.plain:
THE LIFE DIRECTION TEST

TRIGGER
Values, meaning & loss

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

GOAL
A thought can sound true and still drive badly.

1. Picture — Picture two arrows. Life Direction — feel support.
2. Make Room — One shows the next hour if you obey the thought; the other reveals what unfolds over sixty minutes when you make room for it but follow a chosen value.
3. Name Likely — Name the likely behaviour at each arrow’s end. Life Direction — split duty.
4. Select Direction — Select by direction, not by mental volume. Life Direction — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Select Direction.

WIN SIGNAL
✓ A thought can sound true and still drive badly.

FORMULA FLOW
Picture → Make Room → Name Likely → Select Direction

items.title: CLOSE ONE DOOR FOR THIRTY SECONDS
items.name: CLOSE ONE DOOR FOR THIRTY SECONDS
items.ritual_name: CLOSE ONE DOOR FOR THIRTY SECONDS
items.hook: Spot: A hidden preference often speaks when one door briefly closes.
items.hook_internal: Spot: A hidden preference often speaks when one door briefly closes.
items.game_move: PLAY: Close Door → Reopen Choice → Choose Next
items.game_move_internal: PLAY: Close Door → Reopen Choice → Choose Next
items.goal: A hidden preference often speaks when one door briefly closes.
items.mission: A hidden preference often speaks when one door briefly closes.
items.challenge: A hidden preference often speaks when one door briefly closes.
items.immediate_need: A hidden preference often speaks when one door briefly closes.
items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Perfectionism & performance pressure

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A hidden preference often speaks when one door briefly closes.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Close Door — Picture the two leading options. Cross out one for thirty seconds and pretend it is unavailable; do not commit. Close Door — hear sound.
2. Read Protest — Notice the first specific reaction—relief, disappointment, bargaining, urgency, or no change. Name it in four words or fewer.
3. Reopen Choice — Uncross the option. Repeat once with the other door closed so both reactions receive the same test. Close Door — pick action.
4. Choose Next — Use the clearer reaction as one piece of data, then choose only the next responsible move. Close Door — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Next.
items.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ I just found a next choice without solving my whole future.
items.formula_flow: Close Door → Read Protest → Reopen Choice → Choose Next
items.safety:
PAUSE
Do not use pretend closure for urgent, coercive, unsafe, or irreversible choices.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Some solutions survive only because their costs stay hidden.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Use Control — Name everything used to control the feeling: checking, avoiding, numbing, arguing, reassurance, overworking. Control Graveyard — breathe naturally.
2. Picture Short — Beside each, Picture the short-term payoff and the six-month bill.
3. Focus On Costs — Focus on any method whose bill exceeds its relief. Control Graveyard — allow opposite.
4. Choose Experiment — Choose one experiment in not paying that cost today. Control Graveyard — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Experiment.

items.mission: Defence narrows the world; sense of where you are reopens it.
items.challenge: Defence narrows the world; sense of where you are reopens it.

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Defence narrows the world; sense of where you are reopens it.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Let Eyes — Let your eyes move before your head. Finish Look — soften shoulders.
2. Scan Left — Slowly scan left, centre, right, behind if safe, and toward an exit.
3. Name Cues — Name present cues of choice, support, and distance from threat. Finish Look — notice detail.
4. Allow Neck — Allow the neck to follow only within comfort.
5. Place Attention — End by selecting where attention belongs now. Finish Look — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Place Attention.

items.play_the_loop:
1. Locate Bodily — Locate one bodily sign of steadiness—warmth, pressure, uprightness, ease, or a capable impulse. Track Holds — press feet.
2. Describe Boundaries — Say its boundaries and changes for twenty seconds.
3. Ask Memory — Ask what memory, person, posture, or environment strengthens it by one degree. Track Holds — name feeling.
4. Add Ingredient — Add only that ingredient. Track Holds — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Add Ingredient.

items.title: LET BREATH BREATHE YOU
items.name: LET BREATH BREATHE YOU
items.hook: Twist: Remove the manager from respiration.
items.hook_internal: Twist: Remove the manager from respiration.
items.game_move: PLAY: Follow Breaths → Start → Witness Motion

items.goal: Remove the manager from respiration.
items.mission: Remove the manager from respiration.
items.challenge: Remove the manager from respiration.
items.immediate_need: Remove the manager from respiration.
items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Observer loss & cognitive fusion

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Remove the manager from respiration.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Follow Breaths — Follow three natural breaths exactly as they occur. Let Breath — breathe naturally.
2. Leave Breath Alone — Do not deepen, slow, count, or improve them.
3. Start — Notice where each begins by itself and where it ends without instruction. Let Breath — notice detail.
4. Let Body — Between breaths, let the body choose again.
5. Witness Motion — Your only action is witnessing what already knows how to move. Let Breath — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Witness Motion.

WIN SIGNAL

items.play_the_loop:
1. Choose Slow — Choose a slow, comfortable pace in which inhale and exhale feel smooth. Rhythm Before — loosen hands.
2. Use Quiet — Use a quiet timer or gentle movement as metronome, never forcing lung volume. Rhythm Before — name sensation.
3. Continue Long — Continue long enough to find a repeatable rhythm, then remove the metronome and keep one easy cycle. Rhythm Before — next action.

items.hook: Watch: Symmetry gives attention a simple crossing.

items.game_move: PLAY: Pick Requires → Imagine Pair → Complete Few

items.goal: Symmetry gives attention a simple crossing.
items.mission: Symmetry gives attention a simple crossing.

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Symmetry gives attention a simple crossing.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Pick Requires — Pick a count that requires no effort. Even Bridge — widen gaze.
2. Count Exhale — Inhale for that count, exhale for the same count, and leave any natural pause untouched.
3. Imagine Pair — Imagine each pair forming equal sides of a bridge. Even Bridge — name sensation.
4. Complete Few — Complete a few balanced crossings, then let counting dissolve. Even Bridge — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Complete Few.

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Short-term attention is not permanent storage.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Question Promise — Catch every task, question, promise, and loose obligation into one trusted place. Empty Mental — feel support.
2. Empty First — Do not organise while emptying.
3. Sort Entries — When the mind offers silence, sort entries into do, schedule, delegate, reference, or delete. Empty Mental — notice detail.
4. Choose Physical — Choose only the first physical action. Empty Mental — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Physical.

Attention & cognitive overload

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

Short-term attention is not permanent storage.

3. Sort Entries — When the mind offers silence, sort entries into do, schedule, delegate, reference, or delete. Empty Mental — notice detail.
4. Choose Physical — Choose only the first physical action. Empty Mental — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Choose Physical.

items.play_the_loop:
1. Choose Signals — Choose the two signals fighting for attention. Braid Signals — feel support.
2. Alternate B — Alternate A–B–A–B at a slow fixed rhythm.
3. Hold Time — Then hold both at the same time for one interval, noticing difference without choosing. Braid Signals — notice detail.
4. Decide After — Decide only after the braid is complete. Braid Signals — next action.

items.goal_why_game_move:

items.play_the_loop:
1. Press Equal — Press palms together—or both hands into one cushion—at about twenty percent effort. Keep breathing ordinary. Match Pressure — move slowly.
2. Match Force — Adjust until neither side wins and the pressure feels equal. Hold that match for two seconds.
3. Step Down — Lower both sides together through three gentle levels: fifteen, ten, then five percent. Match Pressure — name feeling.

⚡ FINISH — Reach Zero.

GOAL
Invisible commitments keep using memory until named.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Question Task — Name every unresolved promise, question, task, decision, and waiting item without solving any. Count Every — loosen hands.
2. Use Line — Use one line each. Count Every — notice detail.

⚡ FINISH — Imagine Boundary.

1. Repeat No — Define your personal decline signs in advance: rereading, harsher certainty, slower comprehension, repeated searches, no new distinctions. Mark Quality — feel support.

items.ritual_name: REPLAY THE TURNING POINT AT HALF SPEED
items.hook: Aim: Find the turning point, not another theory about the whole conversation.
items.hook_internal: Aim: Find the turning point, not another theory about the whole conversation.
items.game_move: PLAY: Recall Exchange → Shift → Keep Fact
items.game_move_internal: PLAY: Recall Exchange → Shift → Keep Fact
items.goal: Find the turning point, not another theory about the whole conversation.
items.mission: Find the turning point, not another theory about the whole conversation.
items.challenge: Find the turning point, not another theory about the whole conversation.
items.immediate_need: Find the turning point, not another theory about the whole conversation.
items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Action avoidance & procrastination

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Find the turning point, not another theory about the whole conversation.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Recall Exchange — Choose no more than ten seconds of the interaction, beginning before the moment that felt different. Replay Turning — breathe naturally.
2. Halve Speed — Replay it once in imagination at half speed. Keep to observable words, pauses, volume, face, and movement.
3. Shift — Stop at the first change and name it without motive: ‘the pause lengthened,’ ‘the volume rose,’ or ‘the reply shortened.’. Replay Turning — pick action.
4. Keep Fact — Keep that one fact. End the replay before building another explanation. Replay Turning — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Keep Fact.

items.safety:

2. Multiply — Multiply nothing; simply rank. Give Thoughts — pick action.

items.game_move: PLAY: No Sentences → Spot The Return → Choose An Exit
items.game_move_internal: PLAY: No Sentences → Spot The Return → Choose An Exit
items.goal: A loop is easier to spot when it has to fit on five tiles.
items.mission: A loop is easier to spot when it has to fit on five tiles.
items.challenge: A loop is easier to spot when it has to fit on five tiles.
items.immediate_need: A loop is easier to spot when it has to fit on five tiles.
items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Rumination & worry loops

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A loop is easier to spot when it has to fit on five tiles.
items.play_the_loop:
1. No Sentences — Imagine five boxes. Do not use full sentences. Turn Loop — widen gaze.
2. Imagine Five Signs — Give each of the last five thought turns one simple mental picture.
3. Spot The Return — Notice the first picture whose meaning comes back later. Turn Loop — notice detail.
4. Choose An Exit — At the next box, picture one real fact to check or one small action to take, then stop imagining. Turn Loop — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Choose An Exit.
items.win_reward:
WIN SIGNAL
✓ A loop is easier to spot when it has to fit on five tiles.

PAUSE
Do not Imagine while driving; stop if the Imagine a path becomes compulsive, perfectionistic, or more distressing than the thought.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

items.play_the_loop:
1. Create Memory — Create a memory-like scene set just after completing the action. Remember Future — breathe naturally.
2. Include Time — Include time, location, body posture, one sensory cue, along with what you did when difficulty appeared. Remember Future — name sensation.
3. Look Backward — Look backward from that imagined completion to the first real movement and perform it now. Remember Future — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Look Backward.

items.goal: Crowded choices get clearer when only two enter each round.

items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Automatic habits & autopilot

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Crowded choices get clearer when only two enter each round.
items.play_the_loop:
1. Seed Options — Picture the available options into a simple bracket. Give an unpaired option a bye rather than inventing a rival. Two Option — soften shoulders.
2. Pick Criterion — Choose one criterion that matters for this round and Picture it above the bracket. Do not switch it mid-game.
3. Play Pairs — Compare only two options at a time. Advance the one that better meets the declared criterion. Two Option — notice detail.
4. Crown Next — Crown the final survivor as the next option to inspect or act on—not as a permanent life verdict. Two Option — next action.

⚡ FINISH — Crown Next.

4. Test Outside — Picture one real case where it does not fit.
5. Set Its True Place — Say a smaller, more accurate version of the belief. Give Belief — next action.
